sentences.text: CPU 3 is down, causing ATM latency to rise, and CPU 5 is at 97% with ATM p95 latency at 897 ms, 143 queued requests, and 2.7% timeouts.
The leading hypothesis is capacity loss after the CPU 3 failure, with ATM-AUTH losing 4 servers.
NUMSTATIC keeps a configured floor of static servers, while MAXSERVERS limits total instances.
The static floor cannot exceed the MAXSERVERS ceiling, otherwise PATHWAY error 2049 occurs.
ATM withdrawals are slow because CPU 3 is down, causing capacity loss; ATM-AUTH lost 4 servers and CPU 5 is at 98% utilization.
ATM p95 latency is 892 ms against a 115–201 ms band, with 141 requests queued and 2.6% timeouts.
